parameters.query:
SELECT 
    s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
    s.sentrix_id,
    s.chiptype_ref,
    COUNT(i.uniqueref) AS idat_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.gtc_file_path IS NOT NULL) AS gtc_path_count
FROM scans s
LEFT JOIN idats i 
  ON i.scan_ref = s.uniqueref
WHERE s.sentrix_id = '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'
GROUP BY
    s.uniqueref,
    s.sentrix_id,
    s.chiptype_ref;

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

BASE="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans"
RUN_ID="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
SCRIPT="$BASE/.scripts/dragena_batch_${RUN_ID}.sh"
LOG="$BASE/.logs/dragena_batch_${RUN_ID}.log"
SESSION="dragena_${RUN_ID}"

# Workflow 2 Webhook URL buraya gelecek
WEBHOOK_URL="http://10.20.0.30:5678/webhook/cb56257e-966e-4e4e-b353-214b63f77495"

mkdir -p "$BASE/.scripts" "$BASE/.logs"

cat > "$SCRIPT" << INNER_SCRIPT
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

RUN_ID="$RUN_ID"
BASE="$BASE"
WEBHOOK_URL="$WEBHOOK_URL"

DRAGENA="/staging/tools/dragena-linux-x64-DAv1.4.0-rc2-sha.9b051a4be2c6ade41bfa804c3bccc41cdbdc1c5b/dragena/dragena"
STAGING="/staging/array"
SCANS="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans"

SENTRIX_IDS=(
{{ $json.chips.map(c => `  "${c.sentrix_id}"`).join('\n') }}
)

PROCESSED=()
FAILED=()

for SENTRIX in "\${SENTRIX_IDS[@]}"; do
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "[\$(date)] START \$SENTRIX"
  echo "============================================================"

  CHIPTYPE_REF="126"
  SUBDIR="GSA_Cyto"

  BPM="\$STAGING/\$SUBDIR/GSACyto_20044998_A1.bpm"
  EGT="\$STAGING/\$SUBDIR/2003.egt"
  CSV="\$STAGING/\$SUBDIR/GSACyto_20044998_A1.csv"

  LABEL_PREFIX="GSA_Cyto"

  BPM_CONCEPT_REF="395"
  CSV_CONCEPT_REF="396"
  EGT_CONCEPT_REF="397"

  IDAT_DIR="\$SCANS/\$SENTRIX"

  GTC_ROOT="\$SCANS/GTCs"
  TMP_ROOT="\$SCANS/.tmp_dragena"
  RUN_DIR="\$TMP_ROOT/\$SENTRIX"
  TMP_GTC_DIR="\$RUN_DIR/gtc"
  TMP_QC_DIR="\$RUN_DIR/qc_report"

  LABEL="\${LABEL_PREFIX}_\${SENTRIX}"
  LOCK="\$TMP_ROOT/.dragena_\${SENTRIX}.lock"

  mkdir -p "\$GTC_ROOT" "\$TMP_ROOT"

  if [ ! -x "\$DRAGENA" ]; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"dragena_missing_or_not_executable\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"\$DRAGENA\"}"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  if [ ! -d "\$IDAT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"idat_dir_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"\$IDAT_DIR\"}"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  if [ ! -f "\$BPM" ] || [ ! -f "\$EGT" ] || [ ! -f "\$CSV" ]; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"manifest_or_cluster_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\"}"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  if [ -f "\$LOCK" ]; then
    PID=\$(cat "\$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)

    if [ -n "\$PID" ] && kill -0 "\$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "{\"status\":\"locked\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"pid\":\"\$PID\"}"
      FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
      continue
    else
      rm -f "\$LOCK"
    fi
  fi

  echo \$\$ > "\$LOCK"

  rm -rf "\$RUN_DIR"
  mkdir -p "\$TMP_GTC_DIR" "\$TMP_QC_DIR"

  # Aynı sentrix için eski final GTC dosyalarını temizle
  rm -f "\$GTC_ROOT/\${SENTRIX}"_*.gtc

  "\$DRAGENA" genotype call \
    --bpm-manifest "\$BPM" \
    --cluster-file "\$EGT" \
    --idat-folder "\$IDAT_DIR" \
    --output-folder "\$TMP_GTC_DIR" > "\$RUN_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" 2>&1

  GTC_RC=\$?

  if [ "\$GTC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
    TAIL=\$(tail -5 "\$RUN_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
    echo "{\"status\":\"gtc_failed\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"rc\":\$GTC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"\$TAIL\"}"
    rm -f "\$LOCK"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  "\$DRAGENA" qc report \
    --data "\$TMP_GTC_DIR" \
    --output-folder "\$TMP_QC_DIR" \
    --label "\$LABEL" > "\$RUN_DIR/dragena_qc.log" 2>&1

  QC_RC=\$?

  if [ "\$QC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
    TAIL=\$(tail -5 "\$RUN_DIR/dragena_qc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
    echo "{\"status\":\"qc_failed\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"rc\":\$QC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"\$TAIL\"}"
    rm -f "\$LOCK"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  GTC_COUNT=\$(find "\$TMP_GTC_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "\${SENTRIX}_*.gtc" | wc -l)

  if [ "\$GTC_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"no_gtc_created\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\"}"
    rm -f "\$LOCK"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  QC_XLSX=\$(ls -t "\$TMP_QC_DIR"/DRAGENArray_QC_table_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)

  if [ -z "\$QC_XLSX" ]; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"qc_dir\":\"\$TMP_QC_DIR\"}"
    rm -f "\$LOCK"
    FAILED+=("\$SENTRIX")
    continue
  fi

  find "\$TMP_GTC_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "\${SENTRIX}_*.gtc" -exec mv -f {} "\$GTC_ROOT/" \;

  QC_XLSX_BASENAME=\$(basename "\$QC_XLSX")

  N8N_GTC_DIR=\$(echo "\$GTC_ROOT" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
  N8N_QC_DIR=\$(echo "\$TMP_QC_DIR" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
  N8N_QC_XLSX=\$(echo "\$QC_XLSX" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')

  echo "{\"status\":\"success\",\"run_id\":\"\$RUN_ID\",\"sentrix\":\"\$SENTRIX\",\"chiptype_ref\":\"\$CHIPTYPE_REF\",\"gtc_dir\":\"\$N8N_GTC_DIR\",\"qc_dir\":\"\$N8N_QC_DIR\",\"qc_xlsx\":\"\$N8N_QC_XLSX\",\"qc_xlsx_basename\":\"\$QC_XLSX_BASENAME\",\"label\":\"\$LABEL\",\"gtc_count\":\$GTC_COUNT,\"bpm_concept_ref\":\$BPM_CONCEPT_REF,\"csv_concept_ref\":\$CSV_CONCEPT_REF,\"egt_concept_ref\":\$EGT_CONCEPT_REF}"

  rm -f "\$LOCK"
  PROCESSED+=("\$SENTRIX")

  echo "[\$(date)] FINISHED \$SENTRIX"
done

PROCESSED_JSON=\$(printf '%s\n' "\${PROCESSED[@]}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.dumps([x.strip() for x in sys.stdin if x.strip()]))')
FAILED_JSON=\$(printf '%s\n' "\${FAILED[@]}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.dumps([x.strip() for x in sys.stdin if x.strip()]))')

curl -sS -X POST "\$WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"status\":\"dragena_batch_finished\",\"run_id\":\"\$RUN_ID\",\"processed_sentrix_ids\":\$PROCESSED_JSON,\"failed_sentrix_ids\":\$FAILED_JSON,\"log\":\"$LOG\"}"

echo "[\$(date)] WEBHOOK POST SENT"
INNER_SCRIPT

chmod +x "$SCRIPT"

tmux new-session -d -s "$SESSION" "bash '$SCRIPT' > '$LOG' 2>&1"

echo "{\"status\":\"tmux_started\",\"run_id\":\"$RUN_ID\",\"session\":\"$SESSION\",\"script\":\"$SCRIPT\",\"log\":\"$LOG\",\"chip_count\":{{ $json.chip_count }}}"
BASH_SCRIPT

  i.uniqueref                   AS idat_uniqueref,
  i.position,

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail

SENTRIX="{{ $json.sentrix_id }}"
SCAN_REF="{{ $json.scan_ref }}"
CHIPTYPE_REF="{{ $json.chiptype_ref }}"

DRAGENA="/staging/tools/dragena-linux-x64-DAv1.4.0-rc2-sha.9b051a4be2c6ade41bfa804c3bccc41cdbdc1c5b/dragena/dragena"
STAGING="/staging/array"
SCANS="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans"

# ============================================================
# Chip config
# chiptype_ref = 126 -> GSA_Cyto
# ============================================================
if [ "$CHIPTYPE_REF" = "126" ]; then
  SUBDIR="GSA_Cyto"

  BPM="$STAGING/$SUBDIR/GSACyto_20044998_A1.bpm"
  EGT="$STAGING/$SUBDIR/2003.egt"
  CSV="$STAGING/$SUBDIR/GSACyto_20044998_A1.csv"

  LABEL_PREFIX="GSA_Cyto"

  BPM_CONCEPT_REF="395"
  CSV_CONCEPT_REF="396"
  EGT_CONCEPT_REF="397"
else
  echo "{\"status\":\"unknown_chiptype\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"chiptype_ref\":\"$CHIPTYPE_REF\"}"
  exit 1
fi

IDAT_DIR="$SCANS/$SENTRIX"

# Kalıcı GTC klasörü: burada sadece .gtc dosyaları kalacak.
GTC_ROOT="$SCANS/GTCs"

# Geçici çalışma alanı: QC xlsx burada kalır, n8n okuduktan sonra cleanup node siler.
TMP_ROOT="$SCANS/.tmp_dragena"
RUN_DIR="$TMP_ROOT/$SENTRIX"
TMP_GTC_DIR="$RUN_DIR/gtc"
TMP_QC_DIR="$RUN_DIR/qc_report"

LABEL="${LABEL_PREFIX}_${SENTRIX}"
LOCK="$TMP_ROOT/.dragena_${SENTRIX}.lock"

mkdir -p "$GTC_ROOT" "$TMP_ROOT"

# ============================================================
# Basic validation
# ============================================================
if [ -z "$SENTRIX" ] || [ -z "$SCAN_REF" ] || [ -z "$CHIPTYPE_REF" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"missing_input\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"chiptype_ref\":\"$CHIPTYPE_REF\"}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$DRAGENA" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"dragena_missing_or_not_executable\",\"path\":\"$DRAGENA\"}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "$IDAT_DIR" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"idat_dir_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"$IDAT_DIR\"}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$BPM" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"bpm_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"$BPM\"}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$EGT" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"egt_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"$EGT\"}"
  exit 1
fi

# CSV şu an DRAGENA komutunda kullanılmıyor ama DB concept ref için tutuluyor.
if [ ! -f "$CSV" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"csv_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"path\":\"$CSV\"}"
  exit 1
fi

# ============================================================
# Lock control
# ============================================================
if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then
  PID=$(cat "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)

  if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "{\"status\":\"locked\",\"pid\":\"$PID\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\"}"
    exit 0
  else
    rm -f "$LOCK"
  fi
fi

echo $$ > "$LOCK"

cleanup_lock() {
  rm -f "$LOCK"
}
trap cleanup_lock EXIT INT TERM

# ============================================================
# Prepare temp dirs
# ============================================================
rm -rf "$RUN_DIR"
mkdir -p "$TMP_GTC_DIR" "$TMP_QC_DIR"

# Aynı Sentrix'e ait eski kalıcı GTC dosyalarını temizle.
# Sadece ilgili chip prefix'ine dokunur.
rm -f "$GTC_ROOT/${SENTRIX}"_*.gtc

# ============================================================
# DRAGENA genotype call
# ============================================================
"$DRAGENA" genotype call \
  --bpm-manifest "$BPM" \
  --cluster-file "$EGT" \
  --idat-folder "$IDAT_DIR" \
  --output-folder "$TMP_GTC_DIR" > "$RUN_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" 2>&1

GTC_RC=$?

if [ "$GTC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  TAIL=$(tail -5 "$RUN_DIR/dragena_gtc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
  echo "{\"status\":\"gtc_failed\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"rc\":$GTC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"$TAIL\"}"
  exit 1
fi

# ============================================================
# DRAGENA QC report
# ============================================================
"$DRAGENA" qc report \
  --data "$TMP_GTC_DIR" \
  --output-folder "$TMP_QC_DIR" \
  --label "$LABEL" > "$RUN_DIR/dragena_qc.log" 2>&1

QC_RC=$?

if [ "$QC_RC" -ne 0 ]; then
  TAIL=$(tail -5 "$RUN_DIR/dragena_qc.log" | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -d '"')
  echo "{\"status\":\"qc_failed\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"rc\":$QC_RC,\"log_tail\":\"$TAIL\"}"
  exit 1
fi

# ============================================================
# Validate outputs
# ============================================================
GTC_COUNT=$(find "$TMP_GTC_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "${SENTRIX}_*.gtc" | wc -l)

if [ "$GTC_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"no_gtc_created\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\"}"
  exit 1
fi

QC_XLSX=$(ls -t "$TMP_QC_DIR"/DRAGENArray_QC_table_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)

if [ -z "$QC_XLSX" ]; then
  echo "{\"status\":\"qc_xlsx_missing\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"qc_dir\":\"$TMP_QC_DIR\"}"
  exit 1
fi

QC_XLSX_BASENAME=$(basename "$QC_XLSX")

# ============================================================
# Move GTCs to final GTC root
# ============================================================
find "$TMP_GTC_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "${SENTRIX}_*.gtc" -exec mv -f {} "$GTC_ROOT/" \;

# ============================================================
# Convert server paths to n8n-visible paths
# ============================================================
N8N_GTC_DIR=$(echo "$GTC_ROOT" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
N8N_QC_DIR=$(echo "$TMP_QC_DIR" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')
N8N_QC_XLSX=$(echo "$QC_XLSX" | sed 's|/mnt/koza_alldata|/volume1/ALLDATA|')

# ============================================================
# Success JSON
# ============================================================
echo "{\"status\":\"success\",\"sentrix\":\"$SENTRIX\",\"scan_ref\":\"$SCAN_REF\",\"chiptype_ref\":\"$CHIPTYPE_REF\",\"gtc_dir\":\"$N8N_GTC_DIR\",\"qc_dir\":\"$N8N_QC_DIR\",\"qc_xlsx\":\"$N8N_QC_XLSX\",\"qc_xlsx_basename\":\"$QC_XLSX_BASENAME\",\"label\":\"$LABEL\",\"gtc_count\":$GTC_COUNT,\"bpm_concept_ref\":$BPM_CONCEPT_REF,\"csv_concept_ref\":$CSV_CONCEPT_REF,\"egt_concept_ref\":$EGT_CONCEPT_REF}"
BASH_SCRIPT

parameters.query:
WITH input_json AS (
    SELECT
        $qc$ {{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_control_metrics) }} $qc$::jsonb AS qc
),
params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'::text AS sentrix_id,
        '{{ $json.position }}'::text AS position
),
target_idat AS (
    SELECT
        i.uniqueref AS idat_ref,
        s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
        s.sentrix_id,
        i.position
    FROM idats i
    JOIN scans s
      ON s.uniqueref = i.scan_ref
    JOIN params p
      ON p.sentrix_id = s.sentrix_id
     AND p.position = i.position
),
qc_kv AS (
    SELECT
        kv.key AS qc_key,
        kv.value AS qc_value
    FROM input_json ij
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(ij.qc) AS kv(key, value)
),
metric_values AS (
    SELECT
        ti.idat_ref,
        c.uniqueref AS measurement_concept_ref,
        NULLIF(q.qc_value, '')::numeric AS value_as_number
    FROM qc_kv q
    CROSS JOIN target_idat ti
    JOIN concepts c
      ON c.concept_name = q.qc_key
     AND c.vocabulary_id = 'Illumina'
    WHERE q.qc_key NOT IN (
        'DatasetLabel',
        'Row',
        'Column',
        'ImagingDate',
        'SampleId',
        'SampleName',
        'SamplePlate',
        'SampleWell',
        'ScannerId',
        'ScannerVersion',
        'SentrixBarcode',
        'SentrixPosition',
        'SampleFolderPath',
        'Functional QC Status',
        'Control QC Flag Codes',
        'SexEstimate',
        '_debug_text_length',
        '_debug_reg_positions_count',
        '_debug_first_pos_value'
    )
      AND q.qc_value IS NOT NULL
      AND q.qc_value <> ''
      AND q.qc_value ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
upserted AS (
    INSERT INTO measurement_idats (
        idat_ref,
        measurement_concept_ref,
        value_as_number
    )
    SELECT
        idat_ref,
        measurement_concept_ref,
        value_as_number
    FROM metric_values
    ON CONFLICT (idat_ref, measurement_concept_ref)
    DO UPDATE SET
        value_as_number = EXCLUDED.value_as_number
    RETURNING uniqueref
)
SELECT
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    ti.scan_ref,
    ti.idat_ref,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metric_values) AS metric_value_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upserted) AS upserted_measurement_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN target_idat ti ON TRUE;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.sentrix_id }}'::text AS sentrix_id,
        '{{ $json.position }}'::text AS position,
        '{{ $json.sex_estimate }}'::text AS sex_estimate,
        '{{ $json.gtc_dir }}'::text AS gtc_dir,

        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.bpm'::text AS bpm_name,
        'GSACyto_20044998_A1.csv'::text AS csv_name,
        '2003.egt'::text AS egt_name
),
scan_ref AS (
    SELECT
        s.uniqueref AS scan_ref,
        s.sentrix_id
    FROM scans s
    JOIN params p
      ON s.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
),
concept_refs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.bpm_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS bpm_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.csv_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS csv_concept_ref,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.concept_name = p.egt_name THEN c.uniqueref END)::bigint AS egt_concept_ref
    FROM concepts c
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE c.concept_name IN (p.bpm_name, p.csv_name, p.egt_name)
),
updated AS (
    UPDATE idats i
    SET
        gtc_file_path = p.gtc_dir || '/' || p.sentrix_id || '_' || p.position || '.gtc',
        estimated_gender = NULLIF(p.sex_estimate, ''),
        manifest_bpm_concept_ref = cr.bpm_concept_ref,
        manifest_csv_concept_ref = cr.csv_concept_ref,
        cluster_file_concept_ref = cr.egt_concept_ref,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM params p
    JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
    CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
    WHERE i.scan_ref = sr.scan_ref
      AND i.position = p.position
      AND cr.bpm_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.csv_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
      AND cr.egt_concept_ref IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING i.uniqueref
)
SELECT
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref,
    COUNT(u.uniqueref) AS updated_idat_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN scan_ref sr ON sr.sentrix_id = p.sentrix_id
CROSS JOIN concept_refs cr
LEFT JOIN updated u ON TRUE
GROUP BY
    sr.scan_ref,
    p.sentrix_id,
    p.position,
    cr.bpm_concept_ref,
    cr.csv_concept_ref,
    cr.egt_concept_ref;

parameters.command:
=bash << 'BASH_SCRIPT'
TMP_ROOT="/mnt/koza_alldata/Scans/.tmp_dragena"

if [ -d "$TMP_ROOT" ]; then
  rm -rf "$TMP_ROOT"
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_deleted\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
else
  echo "{\"status\":\"tmp_root_not_found\",\"tmp_root\":\"$TMP_ROOT\"}"
fi
BASH_SCRIPT
